title: WO.EXP.DY.------VT.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 492 (TRF(II)-28). WO-EXP-DY is the subject; VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: C-CONT (composite continuance), AFI (affinity insight) and TRS (transition). From C-CONT: STF (source transfer). From STF: INFO-SOLD (information solidification). From INFO-SOLD: RE-CONT (recontinuance). From AFI: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From SPT-DY: POST (postulation). From POST: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From TRS: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From RT-DY: SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars). From SOC-RT-P: ALT-FT (alternative functionalism).
